origin.description: The printed coefficients, the observation count, and the residual degrees of freedom.
origin.details: The printed coefficients, the observation count, and the residual degrees of freedom.
origin.value: coefficients and residual df of an rqs fit
origin.example:
fit <- rq(y ~ x1 + x2, data=df, tau=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
c(as.numeric(coef(fit)), nrow(residuals(fit)), nrow(residuals(fit)) - nrow(coef(fit)))
